summary: TDS filed an 8-K disclosing a proposal to acquire all remaining common shares of Array Digital Infrastructure in an all-stock merger. TDS offers 0.86 TDS common shares per Array share, contingent on closing prior spectrum license sales and Array paying a $10.40/share dividend (~$900M total) before closing. The proposal was sent to Array's board; no board recommendation or advisors named. Structural note: merger consideration is all-stock with an exchange ratio. Regulatory clock not specified. What to watch: Array board response, shareholder vote, regulatory approvals; risk-arb angle focuses on spread between exchange ratio and market prices.
